title: Refunds and cancellations
text: Cancel at least 24 hours before your sample collection slot for a full refund. Cancellations within 24 hours of the slot get a 50% refund. Once the sample has been collected the test fee is non-refundable. Refunds reach your original payment method within 5-7 working days.

title: Home sample collection timing
text: Home sample collection slots run from 6:00 AM to 11:00 AM, Monday to Saturday. The phlebotomist arrives within the 30-minute window you book.

title: Fasting before tests
text: Fast for 10-12 hours before any test that includes glucose or lipids. Plain water is allowed; avoid tea, coffee and juice. Take your regular medicines unless your doctor has told you otherwise.

title: Report turnaround time
text: Most reports are ready within 24 hours of sample collection. HbA1c, vitamin D and vitamin B12 can take up to 48 hours. A FOXO clinician reviews every report before it is shared, and you get an app notification when it is ready.

title: Data privacy
text: Your health data is visible only to you and the FOXO clinicians caring for you. We never share one member's reports or results with anyone else, including family members, unless that member gives consent from their own account.

title: Rescheduling a collection
text: You can reschedule a sample collection for free from the app up to 2 hours before your slot. Within 2 hours of the slot, contact support. Each booking can be rescheduled up to 3 times.
